title: Coordination-activation-v1 resident activation record
description: Separately approved activation window for one exact CoordResidentStartup-v2 descriptor. Kept outside the hashed descriptor so a renewed window leaves the descriptor hash and the registered task unchanged. The host re-reads it from a protected location before every drain.

descriptorSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact v2 descriptor bytes this window applies to.

approvalReference.description: Operator approval that authorizes this window.

exclusionReference.description: Optional writer-exclusion or hold reference bound to the approval.

notAfterUtc.description: Window end. notAfterUtc minus notBeforeUtc must not exceed 12 hours; the host refuses a longer window (ResidentActivationWindowTooLong). JSON Schema cannot express the difference, so the reader enforces it.

maximumDrains.description: Drain limit per host process; 0 means bounded only by the window.
